title: Control-OFF flagged-token re-bind runs only when the agent names a root again, and ignores the bind backoff
outcome: A turn-gated-control OFF session whose restored token a reload flagged gets its pending verification records delivered even if its agent never names a source root again. Either a re-bind trigger exists that does not depend on re-naming, or the limitation is documented and the coordinator has accepted it. The naming re-bind of a flagged token respects the session's bind backoff (circuit_open and next_bind_retry_at) as the other binders do, or the coordinator has recorded why it doesn't need to.
acceptance: either a control-OFF session with a reload-flagged token and pending verification records is re-bound without its agent naming a root again, with a test showing the records delivered; or the limitation is documented in docs/features and the coordinator has concurred in a note
the flagged-token naming re-bind consults circuit_open and next_bind_retry_at with a test, or the coordinator has recorded in a note why the naming budget makes that unnecessary
